name: Hello
description: Template module in C# (.NET 8): prints a greeting from its settings file and exits.
notes: Template (C# on .NET 8 is the default for new modules). Copy this folder to modules/<id>/ and follow docs/module-contract.md section 14. For a tray or window module: set OutputType WinExe and UseWindowsForms true; set single true and the three instance names; call SingleInstance.TryStart in Main.
